timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Floor, wall panels, and ceiling render in stark unshaded white. Heavy lighting blowout clips geometry outlines. Pilot consoles lack material contrast.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: 1) Light energy values calibrated for Three.js rect lights were used directly in Godot OmniLights causing overexposure. 2) MultiMeshInstance3D discarded surface materials because models with multiple surfaces had overrides assigned on Node level rather than Mesh ArrayMesh surface level.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Player attempts to cross from central corridor into side cabin/room and drops into black void space below the ship.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: Spine corridor was defined with width x in [-2, 2], while room boundaries start at x = -3 and x = +3. This created a 1.0-meter wide uncollided, unfloored hole along the entire length of the ship at every threshold.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Bed frames, desks, nightstands and lockers appear solid flat grey/white without Quaternius sci-fi palette swatches.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: Palette.resolve() returned empty swatch when material name from GLB was generic or empty, defaulting to Godot base StandardMaterial3D (pure white).

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Looking out of observation windows shows pitch black rectangles with zero transparency and no space backdrop.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: 1) Hull shell was generated as a closed continuous box encasing viewports. 2) M_Glass material was authored with opaque blend mode.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Falling outside the ship reveals a solid black void. No stars, nebula, skybox or celestial bodies visible.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: WorldEnvironment was initialized with background_mode = BG_COLOR (black) rather than procedural sky / panorama HDRI.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Chairs, couches, and kitchen counters blend into floor/walls. Some props appear invisible or missing due to zero-contrast white-on-white rendering.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: MultiMesh batching grouped all instances together under a single material override, stripping individual prop textures.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Medical pods and fluid cylinders appear flat; fluid emission and glass transparency fail to render.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: StandardMaterial3D lacked transparency flag and emission energy multipliers were overridden.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Door frames have visible seams where corridor floor terminates before room floor begins.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: Corridor branch rectangles did not span the full offset to lateral room coordinates.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Console logs throw runtime exceptions when instantiating reactor core and fluid cylinders.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: ship_rooms_engineering.gd called core.host.add_child() instead of core.add_child(), throwing Invalid access on Node3D.

timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Screen display materials and radial blur shader trigger compilation warnings/errors in Godot 4.3.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: SCREEN_TEXTURE keyword used without uniform sampler2D hint_screen_texture declaration in Godot 4.3.

timeline_analysis.bug_category: Ramp Collision & Loop Variable Type Inference
timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Ramp grip rails and collision geometry throw GDScript parse errors during autoload compilation.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: Untyped loop variables in GDScript (for sx in [-1.0, 1.0]) caused strict warning-as-error compilation failures.

timeline_analysis.bug_category: Null Reference in Engine Process Loop
timeline_analysis.visual_symptoms: Rapid error spam in debugger: Invalid access to property or key active on a base object of type Nil.
timeline_analysis.underlying_code_cause: _process() and _unhandled_input() accessed flight.active and warp.is_active() before system nodes were fully instantiated.
